lead.headline: Guttmacher puts Texas, a total-ban state, at 3,530 abortions a month in early 2026: up 26%, one December 2024 jump
lead.number: Texas averaged 3,530 a month in Jan-Mar 2026 (range 3,017-4,147) vs 2,797 in Jan-Mar 2024 (+26%); flat since the Dec 2024 jump.
lead.watch_out: The jump sits right on a method seam: ban-state months before Jan 2025 carry no low-high range, every month after does. Guttmacher also publishes this trend itself.
